inventory.observed: One spectrograph schematic, left to right: an unlabelled entrance slit/source point at the left wall; converging lens L1; triangular glass prism P inside a central housing; converging lens L2; a right-hand screen with two separate dark image marks.
relationships: The entrance/slit lies before L1 and the prism lies between L1 and L2.
L1 belongs to the left collimating section; L2 belongs to the right focusing section.
The screen is beyond L2, not before the prism.
The two lenses and prism are hatched glass objects.
The enclosing tube has left and right tapering sections and a bowed central upper/lower outline. The right screen is slightly tilted.

inventory.observed: Two forward-directed rays leave the same left entrance point, diverge to upper and lower parts of L1, and then run approximately parallel to the upper and lower traversals of the prism.
relationships: Both source rays actually reach L1.
Both collimated paths enter the prism's left sloping face and leave its right sloping face.
Neither lower ray bypasses the prism through its base or outside its outline.

inventory.observed: The upper and lower prism traversals produce paired emergent paths toward L2. After L2, the upper/lower paths for each color meet at one of two distinct screen points.
relationships: Prism exit, L2 passage and screen arrival are connected, not disconnected decorative strokes.
The same-color upper/lower emergent rays represent a collimated bundle before L2.
L2 bends each bundle toward its own focused slit image.
The red image is above the violet image on the screen.
The two wavelengths do not collapse to one image or remain an unfocused parallel beam on the screen.
The dispersion bends the paths toward the prism base, with violet displaced more than red.
inventory.sourcePrecision: The rough monochrome scan is not a scale optical construction. The conserved evidence is incidence order, paired collimated bundles and two separate focused image connections, not exact scan slopes.

observedLabels.location: right of the upper screen image
right of the lower screen image

relationships: The red/violet words label separate screen image marks, not the entrance slit.
The source has no numerical dimensions, axis labels or tick scale.

sourceLimitations: All source rays are black. Colors are identified by the two screen labels. No actual wavelength, refractive index, prism angle, focal length or true-to-scale housing measurement is given.
reviewDiscipline: Viewed the canonical full image once. No crop, replay, preview, candidate spec, render report, SVG, or edition template was inspected before this freeze.
